interruption_1.cause: Claude Code reaped its background shells because the system was critically low on physical memory while the session was idle; the runner was killed with its pool. Not a runner error.

resources_before_resume.probe: fit_one on smoke-seed data (offset 5,000,000), K=10, num_iter=3, cells B/O/A-b-9; no main-data score computed

worker_decision.reason: measured worker peak ~110 MB -> 8 workers ~0.9 GB of ~7.8 GB available; the pressure came from the rest of the system, so halving workers would save <0.5 GB and double the exposure time. Frozen runner and protocol unchanged.
worker_decision.safeguard: external watchdog stops the run (process tree) if Available MBytes < 1200 on two consecutive 30 s samples; the frozen resume rule then applies

resume.rule: frozen resume_rule in protocol.json; 272 recorded fits not re-run; 328 run with frozen seeds
